name: Legs A — squat & hinge
summary: Heavy, low-rep leg strength for downhill durability (the quads failed in the last 15 km of 2022). Same session every time; the weights climb by double progression: hit the top of the rep range on every set and the app adds weight next time.
equipment: Barbell and rack (or Smith machine), dumbbells, step or plate for calves.
when_to_use: Quality-run days, at least 6 hours after the run. Never the day before a long run or within 5 days of a race that matters.

exercises.name: Back squat
cues: Warm up: empty bar ×10, then 2–3 lighter sets of 3–5
Brace, sit between the hips, knees track over toes
Depth you can control with a neutral back; drive up through the whole foot
Stop 1–2 reps before failure — no grinding
exercises.why: Quad and glute strength — the engine for the long Down Run descents.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft knees, push the hips back, bar slides down the thighs
Stop when the hamstrings are tight — usually just below the knee
Flat back throughout; squeeze glutes to stand
exercises.why: Hamstrings and glutes under load — protects against late-race hamstring cramps and supports the hips.

exercises.name: Calf raise, straight knee
cues: Balls of the feet on a step, full stretch at the bottom
Rise high, pause 1 s, lower over 3 s
exercises.why: Gastrocnemius strength — and the ankle stability your posterior tibial area needs.

exercises.name: Calf raise, bent knee
exercises.load: seated machine or dumbbell on knee
cues: Knees at about 90°, weight on the thighs
Full range, slow down, pause at the top
exercises.why: Soleus — the calf muscle that carries the most load per stride in long runs.
